fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix SKHY rose 3.8% intraday to $127.30 on NVIDIA's strong earnings and expanded long-term memory supply commitment news.
fields.summary_ko.1: NVIDIA's supply commitment expanded from $279B to $390B (approximately 39% increase), strengthening multi-year memory procurement, with SK Hynix as major HBM supplier increasing future demand certainty.
